name: Majima Yui
source:
Saki's best friend and classmate who is a cheeky and pure tsundere. Her grades aren't as good as Saki's, but she's even better at sports, especially at swimming. For some reason, Yui claims to be the protagonist's rival.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=729464&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
